package rulefixtures

import "time"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_garbage_collection_cleanup_ticker_not_stopped_on_exit: Layer: Garbage collection and cleanup. Flag time.Ticker creation without a visible Stop path in services or workers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario543Positive(work func(), interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	for range ticker.C {
		work()
	}
}

func scenario543StartWorker(fn func()) {
	go scenario543Positive(fn, 100*time.Millisecond)
}
